summary: Re-tested the two fixes from iteration 14. FUNCTIONAL: BOTH FIXES PASS. (1) Profile tab as guest is NO LONGER blank — [data-testid=profile-guest] renders with all required content: 'ACCOUNT' title, person-circle-outline icon, 'Sign in to unlock premium content' heading, sub-text, and the [data-testid=profile-guest-signin] 'SIGN IN WITH PHONE' button. Tapping the button navigates guest to /auth/phone. (2) home-play-live 'WATCH LIVE' hero button now correctly short-circuits for guests: no player toggle() fires, no audio starts, router pushes /auth/phone. Verified via /player URL check + /auth/phone URL check. After admin OTP login (+250798875272 → testCode 123456), the Profile tab now renders [data-testid=profile-screen] with sub-card / upgrade-btn / logout-btn visible (guest view no longer shown). Tapping WATCH LIVE from home as authed user opens /player and starts the radio stream (no auth redirect). The inline override at profile.tsx:39 does not switch it to column, so the icon (72px), title, sub-text, and SIGN IN button lay out HORIZONTALLY inside a 358px card. Result: 'Sign in to unlock premium content' wraps into a 57px-wide vertical column, sub-text into an 89px column, and the SIGN IN WITH PHONE button is 193px wide starting at x≈340 — its label is CLIPPED to 'SIGN IN WIT…' (H PHONE is off-screen). Everything is testID-accessible so tests pass, but a real user sees a broken card. This is a small style-only fix — add flexDirection:'column' to the inline override or introduce a dedicated guestCard style. No backend testing performed this iteration (out of scope per request).

rca_of_issue: Guest card visual bug RCA: profile.tsx:39 uses `[styles.userCard, { alignItems: 'center', paddingVertical: spacing.xl, marginHorizontal: 0 }]`. The base `styles.userCard` (line 153) declares `flexDirection: 'row'` for the AUTHENTICATED avatar+name layout. When reused for the guest view, the inline override forgot to switch to `flexDirection: 'column'`. React Native still lays it out row, so icon/title/subtext/button sit side-by-side inside 358px. Reproduction: open app as guest → tap Profile tab → observe the ACCOUNT card. Expected: vertical stack with full-width button. Actual: horizontal row with clipped button label ('SIGN IN WIT...'). Mitigation: add `flexDirection: 'column'` to the inline override, or introduce a separate `guestCard` StyleSheet block.
